diagnoses.description: Clickable graphics + text overlay: current Skill guidance/examples bind events directly to circles and place labels separately, which commonly causes the text layer to intercept pointer events (click/hover) and break selection/tooltip. The Skill lacks an explicit requirement to disable pointer events on labels or to attach handlers to a parent <g> so both circle+text are clickable.
diagnoses.evidence: Location hint points to clickable graphics and text overlay acceptance. In bubble_chart_example.js, events are attached to circles only, but typical implementations add <text> labels on top; without pointer-events handling, clicks land on text not circle. SKILL.md click handler section doesn't mention pointer-events on labels or grouping.

diagnoses.description: Two-way linking (bubble <-> table) is underspecified and inconsistent across examples: bubble_chart_example.js calls selectBubble() which calls highlightTableRow(), while interactive_table_example.js uses selectRow() which calls highlightBubble() (not defined). This mismatch encourages partial one-way linking or broken callbacks.
diagnoses.evidence: bubble_chart_example.js: selectBubble() -> highlightTableRow(ticker) if function exists. interactive_table_example.js: selectRow() -> highlightBubble(ticker) if function exists, but no highlightBubble implementation is provided in the bundle. Naming is inconsistent (selected vs highlighted classes) and there is no single shared selection state contract.

diagnoses.description: Acceptance checks for bidirectional interaction are missing: the Skill does not instruct the agent to verify that (1) clicking label text triggers the same selection as clicking the bubble, (2) selection is synchronized both ways, and (3) selection styling is applied consistently and cleared correctly.
diagnoses.evidence: SKILL.md provides generic click handler snippet but no explicit verification checklist for two-way linking or text overlay clickability. The hint explicitly mentions '覆盖文字层与双向联动验收'.

quality_impact.rationale: Repairs address two common failure modes for this task class: (1) label text intercepting pointer events, breaking click/hover; (2) inconsistent callback naming causing one-way or broken chart-table linking. Added explicit patterns and acceptance checks reduce likelihood of producing a non-clickable or non-synchronized UI.

trigger_precision.rationale: Changes target the Skill boundary around interactive D3 patterns (clickability with overlays and bidirectional selection) without encoding task-instance specifics (no stock fields, no layout constants). Guidance is reusable for any labeled marks + linked table scenario.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Diagnoses attribute faults to missing/ambiguous Skill guidance rather than assuming agent non-compliance, and make required checks explicit (click label, verify two-way selection). Some remaining risk exists because host apps may still ignore the contract, but the Skill now clearly instructs what to implement and verify.

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Provides two implementation paths (group-level handlers or pointer-events none on labels) and a robust selection contract with fallbacks. Covers edge cases like missing setSelection and ensures selection clearing behavior is specified.

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: The bundle previously encouraged brittle interactivity: labels could block clicks and the table/chart linkage used mismatched function names. The update adds a clear, reusable interaction contract and explicit overlay clickability guidance plus acceptance checks, improving reliability for interactive D3 web apps.
